caveats: A first make formal-full of the flow of c1a7c85, started in the work tree, is not counted: formal/run.sh was edited while it ran and it stopped with status 2 in step 10; the full run of that flow was then made in a clean export of c1a7c85 (git archive).
The flow of this record was not yet committed when the runs were made; inputs.sha256 fingerprints it.
The runs of the flow of this record used the EXT proof at depth 3 with 17 EXT mutants; the usage comment of formal/run.sh was corrected afterwards (13 -> 17), no executed line changed.
Wall times depend on the host and its load and are never compared.

What is and is not proven: formal/README.md section 5 (item 9 for the EXT unit: the decoder's map from instruction word to payload, payloads the decoder never builds, and everything downstream of Execute are outside the proof).
